# RadioScout

> RadioScout is a free worldwide radio player — top stations, genre search, favourites and history, on the web and Android. TanStack Start SSG on Cloudflare Pages plus an Android APK from the same artifact via Capacitor. Local-first IndexedDB state, type-safe with Zod, Base UI and Tailwind.

Built with React 19, Vite, TanStack Router/Start/Query, Dexie, Capacitor 8. Source at [github.com/Double77x/radioscout](https://github.com/Double77x/radioscout). Every route prerenders to static HTML.

For agents working on the RadioScout codebase, read the guidance files below before making changes — they encode the project's strict logic, performance, accessibility and styling conventions.

## Documentation

- [CODING_STANDARDS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md): Strict logic, performance, accessibility and linting rules. Read first.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): High-level system design and data flow.
- [STYLE_GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md): Visual tokens, themes and animation patterns.
- [TECH_STACK.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/TECH_STACK.md): Complete list of libraries and versions.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Planned features and direction.

## How to play a station (agentic use)

Give the user audio with one navigation — the URL is the API:

- `https://radioscout.pages.dev/?play=kisstory` — play by curated alias or name.
- `https://radioscout.pages.dev/?play=bbc-radio-1` — aliases use lowercase hyphens.
- `https://radioscout.pages.dev/?station=<uuid>&play=1` — deterministic play when you know the uuid.
- `https://radioscout.pages.dev/?q=kisstory` — search without autoplay; pick a row.
- `https://radioscout.pages.dev/?station=<uuid>` — open the detail sheet without autoplay.

Resolution: exact uuid first, then the curated alias table, then free-text directory
search (first playable `https://` hit). The `play` param is stripped after resolving,
so refresh never replays. Only `https://` streams play on web. Full contract:
[AGENTIC_PLAY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/radioscout/main/docs/AGENTIC_PLAY.md).

Stable hooks for browser agents: `data-testid="radio-search"` (search input),
`data-testid="station-row"` + `data-testid="station-play"` (per-station row and play
button), `data-testid="player-dock"` + `data-testid="player-toggle"` (dock).

## Tools

- [RadioScout home](https://radioscout.pages.dev/): Search, genre chips, Most loved / Best of British / Saved / Recently played, persistent player dock.
- Quick Find (`Ctrl/⌘+K` on the site): fuzzy search across home sections, pages, external links and theme actions — the fastest route for browser agents.
- [Features](https://radioscout.pages.dev/features): Core capabilities across the web app and Android APK.
